## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION — Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive (Sector Strength) but clear internal divergences warrant caution; Technology megacaps show meaningful downside while cyclicals and materials lead. Confirmation: broad sector participation (10/11) plus major mega-cap weakness (AAPL, NVDA, AMD BELOW TREND) — leadership risk visible.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +26.18%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +13.93%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +12.08% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary also up: AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +8.51%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors represented in Top 5).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology shows uneven performance with large-cap weakness: AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate under pressure: AMT (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND. Financials have notable outliers: CME (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND, AIG (1W: -10.49% | 1M: -0.78%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND; SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND; VLO (1W: +12.08% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%) ABOVE TREND; AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership skewed to cyclicals and select tech — Value/Cyclical style favored.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: AIG (1W: -10.49% | 1M: -0.78%) BELOW TREND; AMD (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND; CCI (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND; ABBV (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.30%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in large-cap tech and select REITs/financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND; SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%) ABOVE TREND; VLO (1W: +12.08% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND; AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present: several megacaps (AAPL, NVDA, AMD, MSFT) show 1W vs 1M mismatches — tactical risk, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed / internal rotation: AMAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%) ABOVE TREND versus AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND. Net: sector up 1W but leadership fractured — watch for consolidation. Sector breadth: overall market breadth strong (10/11 sectors positive) but tech leadership narrow.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Patchy but with leaders: JPM (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.04%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.95% | 1M: +7.13%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +7.23%) ABOVE TREND; counterexamples CME (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND. Financials show rotation into cyclicals/payments — overall constructive but selective.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive mixed: UNH (1W: +2.25% | 1M: +6.30%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +1.19% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND, offset by LLY (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +8.28%) CORRECTION and ABBV (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.30%) BELOW TREND. Sector shows pockets of strength but headline names present short-term exhaustion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclicals/value exposures: Energy (SLB, VLO, PSX), Materials (FCX, DOW), Industrials (LMT, BA) given broad sector participation. Reduce exposure to select large-cap Tech names that remain BELOW TREND (AAPL, AMD, NVDA) and watch for confirmation before re-entering; style: Value/Cyclical over Growth for now.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND — momentum play; SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/commodity sensitivity. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND — watch for further distribution; AMD (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND — monitor downside follow-through.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials and Energy (sector leaders, strong 1W moves, breadth supportive). BEARISH: Technology (leadership fractured) and Real Estate (several REITs BELOW TREND).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND — monitor for break below recent support near prior lows. AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND — watch for continuation if below last pivot. JPM (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.04%) ABOVE TREND — watch 1M breakout for follow-through. SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND — monitor post-news consolidation above breakout.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
BA (+65): Boeing wins $12.8bn defense contracts; BA (1W: +2.97% | 1M: +17.05%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. NVDA (+60): Alibaba/AI order talk; NVDA (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND — bullish news but price is diverging (distribution risk). PSX (+55): Refinery deal lift; PSX (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +1.63%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming momentum.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
TSLA (-55): Competitive pressure headlines; TSLA (1W: +1.58% | 1M: -0.04%) RECOVERY — negative headlines but short-term price bounce, divergence. ABBV (-50): Downgrade noted; ABBV (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.30%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by weakness. ORCL (-50): Big-short headline; ORCL not a top mover this week — monitor for potential follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, favor Value/Cyclical style over Growth given cyclicals and materials leadership. AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +26.18%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major tech names (AAPL, NVDA, AMD) BELOW TREND and bullish NVDA headlines diverging from price — watch for trend confirmation.
